title: Sporoderm-Broken Spore Powder (GLSP) Remodels the Gut Microbiota and Promotes Tryptophan-Derived Indole Metabolites to Maintain Intestinal Homeostasis.
snippet: sporoderm-broken spore powder (GLSP) has been historically documented for its anti-aging and anti-tumor effects. Although several studies have reported that GLSP and related substance may improve physiological function by regulating the gut microbiota, the underlying mechanisms and their effect on intestinal function remains largely unknown.
